text: {"summary":"The k3d-workload-auditor cluster scores poorly on CIS v1.12.0 (48.7, 28 failed), NSA (61.1) and MITRE (62.5). Main risks are four cluster-admin bindings (argocd-manager, helm-traefik, helm-traefik-crd, and the system:masters group), unpatched CRITICAL/HIGH image CVEs in traefik, metrics-server, grafana, loki-gateway, argo-rollouts and cert-manager, and workloads lacking hardening or network policies. The two GitOps/app repos are mostly clean, with only minor findings in k6-load.yaml and a Dockerfile. Kubescape could not scan argocd-lab-app, and node/control-plane checks were not run.","targets":["k3d-workload-auditor","/work/argocd-lab-gitops","/work/argocd-lab-app"],"frameworks":[{"name":"NSA (cluster)","passed":5,"failed":16,"skipped":5,"score":61.1},{"name":"MITRE (cluster)","passed":9,"failed":12,"skipped":5,"score":62.5},{"name":"cis-v1.12.0 (cluster)","passed":49,"failed":28,"skipped":54,"score":48.7},{"name":"NSA (argocd-lab-gitops)","passed":16,"failed":4,"skipped":0,"score":80},{"name":"MITRE (argocd-lab-gitops)","passed":17,"failed":0,"skipped":0,"score":100},{"name":"Trivy PSS (cluster)","passed":8,"failed":9,"skipped":0,"score":null}],"findings":[{"severity":"CRITICAL","title":"Cluster-admin granted to ServiceAccounts argocd-manager, helm-traefik, helm-traefik-crd","resource":"ClusterRoleBinding/argocd-manager, helm-kube-system-traefik, helm-kube-system-traefik-crd","controls":["C-0185","C-0187","KSV-0111","KSV-0044","KSV-0046"],"evidence":"rbac_and_argo shows three ServiceAccounts in kube-system bound to cluster-admin; trivy flags KSV-0044/KSV-0046 on ClusterRole/cluster-admin.","fix":"argocd-manager is a lab GitOps identity and the helm-traefik pair look like k3s Helm-controller defaults. Where possible, replace argocd-manager's binding with a scoped ClusterRole: kubectl delete clusterrolebinding argocd-manager, then bind a least-privilege role. Treat the helm-* bindings as expected k3s defaults (lower risk)."},{"severity":"CRITICAL","title":"Critical CVEs in Traefik v3.6.13","resource":"kube-system/Deployment/traefik","controls":["CVE-2026-65600","CVE-2026-88007"],"evidence":"Trivy reports two CRITICAL CVEs in github.com/traefik/traefik/v3 v3.6.13, the ingress component.","fix":"Upgrade Traefik to 3.7.13 (covers both CVEs; 3.6.23 or 3.7.7 fixes only CVE-2026-65600). For k3s, upgrade k3s or override the traefik HelmChartConfig image tag."},{"severity":"CRITICAL","title":"Critical CVEs in metrics-server, helm-install jobs, grafana and loki-gateway images","resource":"kube-system/Deployment/metrics-server; kube-system/Job/helm-install-traefik, helm-install-traefik-crd; monitoring/Deployment/kps-grafana, loki-gateway","controls":["CVE-2026-33186","CVE-2025-68121","CVE-2026-111497"],"evidence":"Trivy lists CRITICAL grpc CVE-2026-33186 (v1.72.x) in metrics-server and both helm-install jobs, stdlib CVE-2025-68121 in metrics-server, and brotli-libs CVE-2026-111497 in grafana and loki-gateway.","fix":"Update grpc to 1.79.3; Go stdlib to 1.24.13/1.25.7/1.26.0-rc.3; brotli-libs to 1.2.1-r0 (rebuild/bump the images, e.g. via the grafana and loki chart image tags). metrics-server and the helm jobs are k3s add-ons, so fixes come with a k3s upgrade."},{"severity":"HIGH","title":"High CVEs in argo-rollouts, argo-rollouts-dashboard and cert-manager","resource":"argo-rollouts/Deployment/argo-rollouts, argo-rollouts-dashboard; cert-manager/Deployment/cert-manager","controls":["CVE-2026-78667","CVE-2026-78669","CVE-2026-97031","CVE-2026-111943","CVE-2026-84304","CVE-2026-84445","GHSA-hrxh-6v49-42gf","CVE-2026-56854","CVE-2026-116587"],"evidence":"Trivy lists many HIGH CVEs in Go stdlib v1.26.7/v1.26.8, grpc v1.80.0, x/net, x/crypto, x/text, otel, klauspost/compress and go-jose in these three workloads (cluster totals: 1018 HIGH, 1237 MEDIUM, 12 CRITICAL).","fix":"Upgrade to releases built with Go >=1.26.10 or 1.27.3, grpc >=1.83.2, x/net >=0.60.0, x/crypto >=0.55.0, x/text >=0.41.0, otel >=1.41.0, klauspost/compress >=1.18.7, go-jose >=4.1.6."},{"severity":"HIGH","title":"Wildcard and sensitive RBAC permissions across ClusterRoles","resource":"ClusterRoles incl. admin, alloy, argo-rollouts, cert-manager-cainjector, external-secrets-cert-controller, k3s-cloud-controller-manager, local-path-provisioner-role","controls":["KSV-0041","KSV-0045","KSV-0114","KSV-0053","KSV-0056","KSV-0048","C-0015","C-0186","C-0007","C-0188","C-0037","C-0279","C-0280","C-0281","C-0282"],"evidence":"Trivy flagged 21 roles managing secrets (CRITICAL), 2 with wildcard verbs, 2 managing webhookconfigurations; kubescape shows 26 ServiceAccounts able to list secrets and 30 with delete rights.","fix":"Review each role and scope verbs/resources to the minimum, e.g. replace rules with explicit resources and verbs (`kubectl edit clusterrole <name>`). Built-in roles (admin, edit, system:*, k3s components) are expected; prioritise alloy, argo-rollouts and the cert-manager/external-secrets roles."},{"severity":"HIGH","title":"Secrets or credentials in configuration","resource":"argo-rollouts/ConfigMap/argo-rollouts-notification-configmap; batch/v1/kube-system","controls":["KSV-0109","C-0012","KSV-01010"],"evidence":"Trivy flags KSV-0109 on the argo-rollouts notification ConfigMap and kubescape C-0012 flags 2 resources (example batch/v1/kube-system); the trivy secrets scan returned no findings.","fix":"Move any credentials to a Secret (managed via external-secrets) and reference it: `kubectl -n argo-rollouts get cm argo-rollouts-notification-configmap -o yaml` to review."},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"Node-exporter host access (expected)","resource":"monitoring/DaemonSet/kps-prometheus-node-exporter","controls":["C-0038","C-0041","C-0048","KSV-0009","KSV-0010","KSV-0121","KSV-0023","KSV-0001"],"evidence":"Digest shows host network, host PID and hostPath mounts on node-exporter, which is expected behaviour for this exporter.","fix":"Accept as expected; restrict with a dedicated namespace PodSecurity exception (`kubectl label ns monitoring pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=privileged`) and keep other monitoring workloads restricted."},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"k3s kube-system add-on hardening gaps (expected)","resource":"kube-system: svclb-traefik, coredns, local-path-provisioner, metrics-server","controls":["C-0046","KSV-0024","KSV-0014","KSV-0012","KSV-0022","KSV-0117","KSV-0026","KSV-0037","DS-0002","DS-0013","KSV-0001"],"evidence":"Trivy and kubescape flag host ports, added capabilities, root users, writable root FS and unsafe sysctls on the k3s-managed add-ons (e.g. KSV-0024 on svclb-traefik).","fix":"These are k3s-managed and expected; track via k3s upgrades rather than patching in place."},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"Workloads lack security contexts, limits, non-root, seccomp","resource":"demo-dev, demo-prod, argo-rollouts, cert-manager, external-secrets and others (32 workloads for C-0211)","controls":["C-0211","C-0270","C-0271","C-0013","C-0055","C-0210","KSV-0118","KSV-0104","KSV-0014","Trivy PSS 10/13/14/16/17"],"evidence":"Kubescape reports 32 resources failing C-0211, 30 missing CPU limits, 21 missing memory limits and 23 not non-root; Trivy flags demo-api ReplicaSets for KSV-0118 and KSV-0104.","fix":"securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}, capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}}; resources: {limits: {cpu: 500m, memory: 256Mi}}"},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"No network policies; broad namespace admission and SA token mounting","resource":"28 workloads (C-0030); 12 Namespaces (C-0206); 25 workloads auto-mounting SA tokens","controls":["C-0030","C-0206","C-0054","C-0034","C-0190","C-0053","C-0189","C-0193","C-0202","C-0197","C-0198","C-0199","C-0201","C-0203","C-0204","C-0209"],"evidence":"Kubescape shows 28 workloads without ingress/egress blocking, 12 namespaces without NetworkPolicies, 25 auto-mounting service account tokens, and 13 Namespaces failing the CIS 5.2.x admission controls.","fix":"Add a default-deny NetworkPolicy per namespace (podSelector: {}, policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]) and set automountServiceAccountToken: false where the API is not needed; label namespaces with pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=baseline."},{"severity":"LOW","title":"Untrusted-registry and misc image/config items","resource":"32 workloads (KSV-0125); demo-dev, demo-prod","controls":["KSV-0125","KSV-0049"],"evidence":"Trivy flags 32 resources for KSV-0125 (images outside trusted registries) and 9 roles for managing configmaps (KSV-0049).","fix":"Define trusted registries in an admission policy (Kyverno or ValidatingAdmissionPolicy) and pin images by digest."},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"k6-load manifest hardening gaps in gitops repo","resource":"apps/demo-api/base/k6-load.yaml (argocd-lab-gitops)","controls":["KSV-0014","KSV-0125","KSV-0011","KSV-0020","KSV-0021","KSV-0110","C-0270","C-0013","C-0030","C-0017"],"evidence":"Trivy config reports 1 HIGH, 1 MEDIUM and 4 LOW misconfigs on k6-load.yaml; kubescape shows 3 resources failing C-0270, C-0013, C-0030 and C-0017.","fix":"Add to the container: securityContext: {readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 10001, runAsGroup: 10001}; resources.limits.cpu: 500m; set metadata.namespace explicitly (not default)."},{"severity":"LOW","title":"Dockerfile has no HEALTHCHECK","resource":"services/demo-api/Dockerfile (argocd-lab-app)","controls":["DS-0026"],"evidence":"Trivy config reports DS-0026 (LOW), the only finding in argocd-lab-app.","fix":"HEALTHCHECK CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/healthz || exit 1"},{"severity":"LOW","title":"Platform-default cluster-admin for system:masters","resource":"ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin","controls":["C-0185","KSV-0111"],"evidence":"rbac_and_argo shows cluster-admin bound to Group system:masters, which looks like the standard Kubernetes default.","fix":"No change needed;
